## History

Rogerson is a middle-aged lady who taught a Sunday-school class for twenty years. She instructed her class on a Sunday morning when [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) attended alone in a flower-garlanded hat. Following the service, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) described her experience in Rogerson's class as miserable.
